notes.title: Parallel Pals Demo OUT NOW! Wishlist the main game!
notes.content:
Wishlist the game
Before we get into more details, do not forget to wishlist Parallel Pals on Steam, so when it is released you will be reminded :)

WISHLIST HERE: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2456500/Parallel_Pals/

Some backstory
Parallel Pals Demo was a short game made in 10 days for GameDev.tv Game Jam in 2023. You can play the demo here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2456500/Parallel_Pals/

Demo got many positive impressions during the game jam, so we decided to work on it further and make it a full Steam release.

Now
Now we are working on the game, and we want it to be the best version you want. So if you have any ideas, don't hesitate to brainstorm in our Discord Server :) https://discord.gg/WrhPvrrCQB


If you want to get more details about Parallel Pals or our other games, check out our website: https://shahmuradovgames.mailchimpsites.com/
